records.disposition: Retain for Audit Workbench and future monitoring; the base remains usable without a website.

records.title: Unavailable baseline is a third state with evidence
records.decision: The owner selected record-and-proceed for a harness-only migration whose unrelated baseline is unavailable, using the declared reasons and evidence. A failing baseline remains failing; unavailable cannot relabel red as green.
records.why: Host restrictions or pre-existing product conditions otherwise made rooms permanently unmigratable for problems the harness change could not fix.
records.disposition: Capture this explicit owner choice in an ADR linked to ADR-0020; retain its narrow eligibility and honest completion wording.

records.title: Template customization must preserve fixed control wording
records.decision: A placeholder fill preserves the surrounding rule. Changed or dropped authority, privacy and verification wording must be exposed and restored or explicitly recorded as a decision.
records.why: A Forbidden-to-Allowed reversal was misreported as an expected placeholder fill.
records.disposition: Record semantic control fidelity and the review boundary; a similarity report does not authorize the divergence.

records.title: Installed skills carry their own generation and content identity
records.decision: Identify an installed skill by its source release, commit and content hash; an unmarked copy has unknown provenance, not implicit identity with the current source.
records.why: Feedback blamed a new release for stale installed skill text from an older generation.
records.disposition: Capture the source/installed distinction and keep unknown or stale generation visible.

records.title: Historical adoption provenance is distinct from current component provenance
records.decision: Keep the room's original adoption source historical while receipts and markers identify the current installed tools and skills. Reject unknown or contradictory source identity before mutation.
records.why: Rewriting history to the latest release made it impossible to tell what was adopted and what was subsequently updated.
records.disposition: Record the provenance model once across adoption, tools and skills.

records.title: Verify runtime integrity from inside the installed room
records.decision: An installed room can compare its managed runtime with its receipt using local installed capabilities, distinguishing authentic runtime with stale receipt, modified runtime and unavailable source comparison.
records.why: Verification depended on a neighboring source checkout and different defects were collapsed into one drift message.
records.disposition: Capture the standalone integrity guarantee and truthful remedies.

records.title: Presence-only migration must not acquire replacement effects
records.decision: A layout-only route may recognize an existing linked skill and skip it, but cannot install, mark, back up or replace it; explicit update alone may replace supported managed content.
records.why: A harmless presence check inherited destructive-update restrictions and blocked legitimate migration.
records.disposition: Record the effect-specific distinction without granting write-through-symlink authority.

records.title: Repair installed state explicitly without reinstalling or rewriting content
records.decision: Track seeded document generations, provide explicit repair/normalization for owned metadata and preserve bodies; validation itself remains read-only.
records.why: Upstream fixes did not reach existing rooms, and read-only checks risked hiding mutations.
records.disposition: Capture the detection/repair separation and owned-field boundary.

records.title: Line endings are portable record syntax, not semantic state
records.decision: LF, CRLF and CR frontmatter parse equivalently; reading/validation does not rewrite the file, and an editing operation preserves the room's terminator where specified.
records.why: A Windows checkout made valid ADR and Wiki records fail on syntax that macOS fixtures never exercised.
records.disposition: Record the cross-platform preservation contract at the format boundary.

records.title: Diagnostics must communicate consequence, not just severity
records.decision: Make blocking findings visibly distinct from informational findings and retain the registered effects unchanged.
records.why: A valid room looked failed when nonblocking information had the same prominence as a true stop.
records.disposition: Add the operator-facing rationale to diagnostic semantics without changing which work is blocked.

records.title: Classify legacy rooms read-only and expose all setup gaps together
records.decision: Identify genesis, adoption, upgrade or unclassifiable from evidence without mutation; report all missing/unfilled controls and the reconcile-before-migrate order.
records.why: First-error-only refusal produced repeated stops and encouraged copying templates over project-owned rules.
records.disposition: Record the operation-selection and non-destructive classification contract.

records.title: Open follow-ups must remain reachable outside completed specs
records.decision: Unfinished findings need a reachable current owner with truthful blocked/ready state; a completed spec that ordinary entry skips cannot be their only home.
records.why: Several acknowledged problems disappeared from the route arriving agents were instructed to follow.
records.disposition: Capture the ownership/routing invariant; it does not authorize inventing work or dispatching owner-blocked tasks.

records.title: Tests should pin the intended invariant, not incidental global state
records.decision: Verify relevant identities, relationships and actual behavior rather than freezing a global allocator counter or making the test repeat the implementation's mistaken assumptions.
records.why: An unrelated identity allocation broke a focused Canon test, and a permission test reinforced the same false model as the implementation.
records.disposition: Preserve the semantic test boundary and red-first reproduction; passing self-tests alone cannot validate their own assumptions.

records.title: Finish file-changing work with verified, recoverable, reviewable state
records.state: Accepted historical direction; later scope narrowed
records.decision: The owner wanted agents to handle branch safety, verification, relevant documentation, commit, push and review preparation as part of finishing file-changing work, leaving the owner to approve the meaningful result.
records.why: Repeated manual requests to save and prepare review meant the harness was not completing its own workflow.
records.disposition: Preserve the original end-to-end expectation; later no-ceremony and integration-review decisions narrow the early every-message/new-branch formulation.
